Returns at once if the actor is dead (vfunc 0x99 IsDead(1)) or doing a favor. immediate+reset: stops combat (vfunc 0x1C8/8 on a combat controller at +0x160), ends the interrupt package, ends and clears the current package (1406E99E0), then CheckForNewPackage: the package restarts and its procedure's Start resolves the target again. immediate without reset: only CheckForNewPackage, which keeps an unchanged package (no procedure restart).
